messages:
Maya (partnerships): Heads-up — VendorX told us they plan to remove support for our v2 auth header in their marketplace listing in ~60 days. They want all marketplace integrations to use `Authorization: Bearer v3-<token>` instead. Draft notice: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/vendorx-auth-change :eyes:
Ethan (eng-platform): 60 days is tight. Can we provide a compatibility bridge on our side? i.e. accept v2 headers and map to v3 for marketplace calls. We can do an edge-flagged proxy. ETA ~2 weeks for a temporary bridge.
Priya (sdks): We should also ship SDK shims that set the new header automatically. Plan: patch v2.x SDKs with transparent shim and telemetry opt-in. Minimal code example:
```
// older apps
client.setAuth('v2-xxxx')
// shim will exchange and send v3 header to marketplace
```
Can we coordinate release windows?
Grace (marketplace): VendorX says they need clarity on timing to update their listing. Our partner policy requires 90 days for breaking auth changes but marketplace teams can accept less if we provide a bridge + migration docs. I'd push to negotiate 90->75 days if bridge exists.
Liam (hw-partner): FYI some SI flows on the hardware side embed tokens in firmware. That will need an OTA plan. I can run validation tests but need stable canary by day 21.
Ben (legal): Add me to the partner comms. We need to update the marketplace addendum and include a rollback clause. Also confirm which tokens are considered PII.
Priya (sdks): Proposed timeline:
- Day 0: agree bridge + comms
- Day 7: SDK canary patch (npm/yarn/pypi)
- Day 14: bridge in prod behind feature flag
- Day 21–28: SI hardware validation
- Day 60: VendorX cutover
Is everyone ok with that?
Maya (partnerships): That timeline looks reasonable. I'll negotiate an extra 15 days with VendorX if we commit to bridge + docs. I'll also ping VendorX PM @carla to confirm.
Ethan (eng-platform): If we do the bridge we should route bridge metrics to the partnerships dashboard. Kibana query: `logs:service:auth-proxy AND env:prod`.
SDK-bot: sdk-release: canary builds available
- npm: `@redwood/sdk@next-v2-compat`
- pypi: `redwood-sdk==2.9.1rc`
(links: https://ci.redwood/release/3337-canary)
Priya (sdks): Please test the canary and report errors in #eng-qa. Will monitor errors and abort canary if >2% error rate.
Grace (marketplace): I'll draft the partner-facing comms and include migration checklist for partners and SIs. Will share in 24h.
Liam (hw-partner): I'll reserve a validation lab slot for day 21–23 and coordinate with SI leads.
Maya (partnerships): Action items:
- Maya: negotiate +15d with VendorX (by EOD)
- Ethan: prototype bridge (feature-flag) by day 7
- Priya: publish SDK canary + migration snippet
- Grace: partner comms draft
- Liam: SI validation plan
- Ben: update marketplace addendum
I'll update this thread with VendorX reply. Thanks! :thumbsup:
